# dudect-bencher (vendored)

Vendored from [dudect-bencher 0.6.0](https://crates.io/crates/dudect-bencher/0.6.0)
(MIT OR Apache-2.0), patched to use `rand` / `rand_chacha` **0.9** so this sample
shares a single `rand_core` 0.9 with `fips204`. Not published; used only as a path
dependency from `dudect/`.
